_comment: Single source of truth for PROJECT EMX content on emxtweaks.com. The site reads this file directly; nothing here is generated or guessed. Empty arrays render as honest empty states ('No playtest scheduled yet'), never as placeholder content. Add real entries only.

discord._comment: invite = the PROJECT EMX server invite code only (the part after discord.gg/). While it is empty the JOIN DISCORD buttons say 'Invite coming soon' and the member tile reads 'Not connected'. No placeholder invite is ever shown.

status._comment: phase must be one of: development | playtesting | open-beta. 'live' and 'operational' are deliberately not valid values.
status.note: Open beta on Roblox. Still in active development — expect changes between sessions.
